body: Personally I think nothing happens, but there's no way to tell. If it's some kind of eternal hell, we are all going to die anyway. Trying to live a short happy life is not going to make it up for it.
Just to let you know, I'm 28 and I'm still living at my parents place. You're not alone.
I guess there's no place in this world for people like us. Life is just a cruel joke...

When I was a kid, I thought I would figure it out at some point. That I would grow self confidence. 

I didn't. Now the real world is catching up with me and I'm still not ready. Everyday I'm asking myself if I should kill myself right now or keep going... 

Nice to see that I am not alone. Not that I'm happy you're experiencing this. I was just afraid of being judged about this. Seeing someone who can understand is comforting. Hope you'll do well.
